user.title: Add an Android device
user.description: This creates one dedicated webhook for this phone. Configure both Health Connect and Screen Time in Life Dashboard Companion to send to the same webhook URL. Add the integration again for each additional phone.

confirm.title: Configure Life Dashboard Companion
confirm.description:
Use this URL for both the Health Connect and Screen Time webhooks on this phone:

`{webhook_url}`

If you entered an HMAC secret, configure the same signing secret in the app. Submit this step when you have copied the URL.

abort.missing_setup_data: The setup data was lost. Start the integration setup again.

init.description:
